title: The lamps you're not allowed to have.  Exploring the Dubai lamps
summary: Big Clive tears down the Dubai lamp, a Philips LED bulb developed with Dubai's ruler for maximum efficiency and long life. He examines its construction and circuitry, including underrun LEDs and many filament strips.
why: HN points to it as proof that efficient, long-lived LED bulbs can be built and as an example of well-designed lamps.

quote.text: Check out the dubai lamp to see a lamp designed to be efficient and last
